description.p: Find and edit synced lyrics for your offline music library.
Sing-Along scans the music folders you choose, looks up matching synced lyrics, and saves them alongside your audio files.
Lyrics are provided by the LRCLIB service. Sing-Along is an independent project and is not an official LRCLIB client.

ul.li: Added optional automatic lyrics export after bulk downloads, with remembered download and export preferences.
Improved word-by-word syncing, multilingual word splitting, and word segment editing.
Added a configurable keyboard shortcuts menu and shortcut hints.
Added playback speed controls from 0.5x to 2x in the main player and lyrics editor.
Added multiple-line selection, bulk timestamp adjustments, and clearer line timing indicators.
Added search to Albums and Artists, full-text library search, and clickable album and artist names.
Fixed writing embedded lyrics to MP3 files, including malformed ID3v2 comment language fields.
Fixed the Download button continuing to spin after completion and an error in LRCLIB challenge verification.
Redesigned the app UI with a cleaner, more neutral color scheme for better contrast and visual hierarchy in both light and dark modes.
Sped up Albums and Artists list tabs by adding proper indexes in the database.
Fixed individual lyrics export error in the lyrics editor.
Lyrics editor no longer blocks saving when both plain and synced lyrics are empty.
Added ability to import synced lyrics from an .lrc file (via file picker) or directly from clipboard into the lyrics editor.

Removed dead code and refactored the mass lyrics exporter to use a background queue (similar to the downloader). You can now close the export modal and reopen it later via the header button to check progress.
Reduced memory overhead during mass download and export operations by limiting log buffers and removing unnecessary reactive arrays that are causing memory leaks.
Add support for Lyricsfile — an open, extensible lyrics format in YAML syntax
